description: Text is truncated or overflows at 375px width, unreadable without expanding
reproduction_steps: Look for clipped labels or titles
observed_evidence: Found 4 text elements that are truncated: P "Daily decision system" (0px width); P "Log dinner to keep it alive to" (0px width). User must tap to expand.
suggested_fix: Use line-clamp CSS utilities (Tailwind line-clamp-2) and ellipsis for known constraints; test at 320px minimum width.

description: Icon-only buttons have no text, aria-label, or title for screen readers
reproduction_steps: Inspect icon-only buttons (close, menu, back, etc.)
Check for aria-label or title attributes
observed_evidence: Found 6 unlabeled buttons. Screen reader users hear "button" with no context.
suggested_fix: Add aria-label to all icon-only buttons: `<button aria-label="Close menu">×</button>`.
